headline: Earnings jump from a year ago but slip from last quarter
summary_short: Merdeka Battery Materials' Q2 FY2026 EPS was 0.00022 IDR, up 175.0% from 0.00008 IDR a year earlier but down 21.4% from 0.00028 IDR in the prior quarter.
